title: More ways to use the text API
summary:
O3 gained image input, searchgpt got its route straightened out, and the model list and community directory grew.

Added `openai-reasoning` for o3, then added image input alongside text. The new `searchgpt` listing for GPT-4o mini search preview also received a routing fix so the listed name maps to the intended model.

Text model definitions gained tier and community metadata, plus provider-model aliases for GPT-4.1 variants and Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B. The listed `openai-fast` alias changed to `gpt-4.1-nano`.

The project directory now lists DynaSpark, a Pollinations-based Python package for text, image, and audio generation in web and desktop projects.

highlights.title: O3 can take images
highlights.text: Send images alongside text to `openai-reasoning` for visual reasoning. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-reasoning).

highlights.title: GPT-4o mini search preview
highlights.text: Use `searchgpt` to access GPT-4o mini search preview through the text API. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=searchgpt).
